gizmo.title: Hero
gizmo.description: He kiʻi nui, GIF a i ʻole wikiō me ke poʻo a me ke kikokikona ma luna ona, kau ʻia ma nā wahi a pau o ka ʻaoʻao.

configure.title: Kiʻi a i ʻole wikiō
configure.description: He waihona JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4 a i ʻole WebM.

configure.title: Kikokikona pani
configure.description: E wehewehe i ke kiʻi. E waiho hakahaka inā he hoʻonani wale nō.

configure.title: Poʻo
configure.description: Poʻo i hōʻike ʻia ma luna o ka media. E waiho hakahaka no ka ʻole.

configure.title: Kikokikona
configure.description: Kikokikona i hōʻike ʻia ma lalo o ke poʻo, ma luna o ka media.

configure.title: Laulā piha
configure.description: E holo mai kekahi lihi a i kekahi lihi ma kahi o ka noho ʻana ma ke kolamu ʻike.

configure.title: Hoʻopahu kiʻi
configure.description: Pehea e noho ai ke kiʻi ma kēlā me kēia nui pakuhi

advanced.title: Mae
advanced.description: Waihoʻoluʻu i uhi ʻia ma luna o ka media. Me ke poʻo a i ʻole kikokikona aia mau ia, i hiki ke heluhelu ʻia ke kikokikona.

advanced.title: Kiko kikowaena ākeʻa
advanced.description: Ka ʻāpana o ke kiʻi e noho ʻike ʻia ke ʻoki ʻia, mai 0 (hema) a i 100 (ʻākau).

advanced.title: Kiko kikowaena i lalo
advanced.description: Ka ʻāpana o ke kiʻi e noho ʻike ʻia ke ʻoki ʻia, mai 0 (luna) a i 100 (lalo).
